expectations.text: Межі lead time 6 год і advance 60 днів
expectations.evidence: Lead time is fully covered (TS-GT-01 6:00/6:01 pass, TS-GT-02 5:59 fail, Ready). Advance booking is not boundary-tested: the only Ready values are T+30 days (pass) and T+61 days (fail) (TS-GT-05). The 60-day boundary itself (TS-GT-06) is written as 'pass?'/'fail?' and marked Needs clarification (F-6), and nothing just below 60 days is tested. 30 days is not a boundary value. 06 §1.4 '≤ 60 days' at least supports '59d 23:59 → pass' as Ready, and the plan doesn't include it.

suggestions.assertion: Межі lead time 6 год і advance 60 днів
suggestions.reason: It bundles two boundaries, and it is unclear whether marking the exact 60-day point 'Needs clarification' should count. Split it into two assertions and say whether the just-below value (59d 23:59 → pass) must be Ready.
Say whether a section-level source or traceability matrix is enough, or whether each row needs its own source. The two runs differ exactly on this.

No assertion checks the real document conflicts: overlap as 409 (03) vs 422 TIME_WINDOW (06) vs AIRCRAFT/TIME_WINDOW (02), and 403 for SUSPENDED in 03 vs open in 05. Both runs caught these, and an assertion should require it.

No assertion checks that the plan does not invent expected values (e.g. curfew boundary inclusivity, validate response shape). Both runs correctly left these open, but a weaker run could invent them and still pass all 10 assertions.

eval_feedback.overall: Strong, accurate plan. No wrong thresholds, zone values or rule_reference strings were found. It fails only on advance-booking boundary depth, and it has one unflagged assumption about the completion endpoint.
